artifacts.summary: Confirms the two documented sync sites (state-write.sh --allocate-into prefix and validate-state.sh Check 12), identifies a third undocumented site (scripts/test-state-write-concurrency.sh Cases 10-14, sibling of state-write.sh, not under scripts/tests/) and a bash-level counter-advance assertion that also needs updating, and flags four existing test fixtures (Case 12, and test-validate-state.sh Fixtures (c)/(g)) whose expected PASS/FAIL outcome inverts under the corrected membership-based bound. All repository-state figures independently re-measured and confirmed live.

memory_candidates.content: When auditing a two-site 'must stay in sync' invariant documented via cross-referencing header comments in a bash+jq codebase, also grep the whole source store for the shared computed-value names (e.g. combined_max-style bindings) rather than trusting the two named files alone -- test suites can independently duplicate the same max-based assertion in their own fixtures (e.g. a *_concurrency.sh test living as a sibling script rather than under a tests/ subdirectory), and those fixtures' PASS/FAIL expectations can silently invert when the underlying bound's semantics change from max-based to membership-based, even though no production code outside the two named sites changed.
